prediction_text: Direction: Hillary Clinton wins the 2016 US presidential election — the conference panel's consensus call is for Clinton to defeat Donald Trump on 8 November 2016, in line with the polling lead she holds through October. Timing: decided on election day, 8 November 2016, with Clinton taking the White House as the broadly expected result.
basis: This case asks for the forecasting panel's collective judgment at the Costa Mesa conference (the provenance is the panel report itself). The panel-consensus method weighs the established candidate with the sustained polling lead; nothing in the supplied setting gives the panel a configuration strong enough to overturn the favourite, and panel votes of this kind follow the frontrunner absent such a signature. The judgment therefore reproduces the panel call: Clinton. Individual dissenting panellists are a separate case and are not merged into this consensus prediction.
